payload.blocks: Only the H1-plan part of acceptance criterion 5 (one link in plans/260925-documentation-authority-unification/plan.md 12.1). The rest of phase 3 lands without it.
payload.headline: The H1 plan cannot link to the build order: its legacy plan file is refused by the pre-commit plan gate

parts.cause: The plan is a done legacy plan: its frontmatter was invalid YAML (fixable) and it has no 'contract: plan-v1' marker. Adding the marker requires four body sections (source list, outcome, non-goals, owner questions) the old plan never had.

options.does: Phase 3 lands without touching the legacy plan; the build order is still linked from the proposal, reading map and ledger
options.gain: No edit to a closed historical plan; phase 3 lands now
options.harm: One entry point fewer links to the build order
options.label: Drop the H1-plan link from criterion 5

options.cost: One more unit (~20 min) and a review
options.does: A unit quotes its frontmatter, adds the marker and writes the four missing body sections, then adds the link
options.harm: Rewrites a done plan's record beyond this plan's purpose
options.label: Migrate the H1 plan to plan-v1

parts.recommendation: Drop the H1-plan link from criterion 5
parts.what: Phase 3 must add a link to the build order in the H1 plan (section 12.1). Every commit that stages that plan file is refused by the pre-commit plan contract gate.
